metadata.title: Walter Russell Mead — How America Keeps Winning
metadata.guest_role: Bard / Hudson Institute · WSJ Global View

conclusion: Mead's three-century scoreboard is ten letters: UP to UK to US. Maritime hobbits keep beating centralized land empires — Louis XIV, Napoleon, Germany, the Soviets, now China. Pax Americana after 1945 and 1990 is crumbling; American power is not. Xi's nightmare is a US counter-blockade: no oil, no soy, no exports. Market-cap one through twenty is already US tech, but those firms still need the world. Trump's hand mixes Jeffersonians and Jacksonians. Isolationism plus dead Hormuz deterrence is the risk, not China inventing a new sea order.
background: Patrick has wanted Mead for months (intro via Jeremy Stern). Frame is God and Gold plus silicon: why the Dutch-English commercial order won, why China cannot copy it by dropping liberalism, and what Trump does to the postwar system. Topics: four US foreign-policy suits, tech Hamiltonians, India, Iran/Hormuz, Ukraine drones, Taiwan soft blockade, and a medicine/Medicare close.
important_facts: Scoreboard and trap: Mead sums 300 years as UP→UK→US. Dutch 17th-century fleet is ~10,000 seagoing ships; open society plus global trade made them rich while land powers went bankrupt over Silesia and lost India and Canada. China is Louis XIV's bet — match tech and arms without messy democracy. Mead does not think China can beat the hobbits. Xi's night thought is a Taiwan blockade answered by a US counter-blockade 100 miles out: no oil in or out, no manufactured exports, Brazilian and Argentine soy sitting. Chinese oil stockpiles surprised him in the Iran war; the green build (solar, hydro) sits next to as-much-coal-as-possible because the point is autarky, not climate virtue. US trade is roughly one-third hemisphere, one-third Pacific, one-third Atlantic — drop any third and it hurts. AI labs that only sell at home will not stay ahead of China.

Politics and tech: four repeating suits since the 1790s — Hamiltonian (strong state, infra, help US firms abroad; GHW Bush flavor), Wilsonian (democracy and institutions), Jeffersonian (liberty at home, stay out), Jacksonian (honor; crush attackers; look isolationist until Pearl Harbor or 9/11). Clinton-era establishment was Wilson+Hamilton. Trump is Jefferson+Jackson (Vance isolation, Rubio hawk without UN/democracy restoration as the point). 1990s tech said 'we are a global company'; today the fight is whose technosphere wins. Alphabet is not a car company that needs Friedman's flat earth — a 30% jump in janitorial cost from less Mexican labor is a shrug; IP leaks to China are a sin coworkers should report. RSS/BJP: ~86,000 weekly cells; India is the most populous country, 1.4 billion people, one UNGA vote like Liechtenstein. Jaishankar: China revisionist, India reformist. 1980 India GDP was ~60–65% of China's; today ~17% — that gap tempts Beijing toward Asian hegemony.

War and hope: first Ukraine drone shop used toy trucks as mine-layers; months later they barely treat bullet wounds — it is all drones, gray kill zones, two soldiers together. One wounded man took 63 days to evacuate. Ukraine has no navy and still kept the Russian Black Sea fleet out with drones — 'good news for Taiwan.' Xi wants Taiwan but Mead sees no bedside alarm clock; failure would be catastrophic, so the path is a soft blockade (stop in a PRC port for customs) under the radar. Japan treating Chinese control of Taiwan as a threat to Japanese independence is the new variable. Hormuz: Iran hitting a tanker matters less than drones on Gulf desal plants that make cities uninhabitable. Deterrence has eroded; the US has not drawn a Truman/FDR-style red line since Obama. Close: a friend's terminal pancreatic cancer is held by a drug that did not exist a year ago; Mead thinks cheaper, better care in 50 years can shrink the Medicare drag. The cornucopia is arriving faster than politics can sort it.

mental_model.name: Hobbits Keep Winning × Counter-Blockade × Four Suits
mental_model.components: Read the last 300 years as UP→UK→US, not as a rules-based cathedral that must be preserved. Land empires keep trying to match the maritime order without an open society; they look ahead in the middle innings and lose. China is in that line. The wartime tell is seaborne dependence: a US counter-blockade on oil, soy, and exports is Xi's constraint, which is why Beijing stockpiles oil and digs coal while building solar. US power still needs all three trade oceans and a world market for its AI companies. Sort Washington as Hamiltonian/Wilsonian/Jeffersonian/Jacksonian, not left/right; Trump is Jefferson+Jackson. Tech Hamiltonians want a patriotic IP culture, not a flat-earth multinational. Taiwan risk is a soft customs blockade plus Japan rearming, not a D-Day clock. Hormuz risk is desal plants, not just tankers. Drones have already made the US the most vulnerable owner of tanks and ships.
mental_model.application: GOOGL is the named technosphere name — global-company-in-the-1990s that now sits inside great-power competition. TSM is the Taiwan hinge: invasion is not Mead's base case; a quiet blockade and Japan's learning curve are. XLE and Gulf plans only work if Iran cannot make cities unlivable — deterrence, not a new shale thesis. Do not fade US large-cap tech because NATO and the WTO look sick; Mead separates a crumbling system from a charging country. Do not treat China solar as a climate partnership. Do not isolate the AI book to the US TAM. India is a reformist third pole (1.4B, one UN vote), not a China clone. Size traditional platforms as obsolete-faster-than-the-Pentagon-learns.

key_insights.view: The system is dying. The country is not.
key_insights.question: Is America in decline?
key_insights.answer: Pax Americana after 1945/1990 is crumbling. Productivity and the information revolution still have the US charging. China does not get to skip liberalism and win.

key_insights.question: What keeps Xi up?
key_insights.answer: A US ring 100 miles out: no oil, no soy, no exports. Stockpiles and coal are autarky, not green virtue.

key_insights.question: Which suit is in power?
key_insights.answer: Not the Wilson+Hamilton establishment. Isolationists and honor-hawks share a hand. Tech now wants a state that protects IP.

top_investment_implications.thesis: Named 1990s 'global company' now inside the technosphere fight; US already owns market-cap 1–20 — low
Soft-blockade and Japan are the tape, not a D-Day clock; Ukraine drones vs a navy is 'good news for Taiwan' — low
Hormuz and Gulf desal risk is why outside power still has to hold Iran; not a shale print — low

golden_quotes: I don't think China has it in in it to beat us.
Asia's too big for China to eat.
